basis: Accepted 2026-10-01: a strictly sub-1-second goal and 2-second deadline replace policy 1's 2/3-second thresholds. At least 95% of planned requests must be correct and complete within the deadline; whole-request correctness, family floors and invariant gates remain unchanged. Historical rescoring is retrospective, not fresh qualification. Saved-locator mutation robustness stays separate. Freeze policy and baseline evidence before new held-out requests.
uncertainty: Minimum coverage is a practical experiment floor, not statistical certification. Report the two-sided 95% Wilson interval over held-out families whose every planned request is correct and complete within the deadline; related requests and repetitions do not count as independent families. Authored families are not a random sample of production traffic.
